name: strace
summary: Diagnostic, debugging and instructional userspace tracer with host ptrace access
description: strace is a diagnostic, debugging and instructional userspace tracer for Linux. It runs unconfined on immutable Linux hosts to trace system calls, signal deliveries, and process state changes without sandbox restrictions.

curation.unconfined_reason: Requires unconfined access to host process IDs (PIDs), ptrace syscall, and host /proc for system call diagnostics
